actual_measurement_definitions.native.common_content_utility_sum: For each accepted native decision occurrence, use the fixed common content panel arithmetic mean rating of original title, abstract and topics; subtract 3 from each mean before summing, preserving repeated accepted records. Native reviewer overall_score and institution-written final_score are not inputs; this is an abstract-based opinion, not scientific truth.
actual_measurement_definitions.native.collected_activity_resource_cost: Sum actual collected original annual-research, production/submission, resubmission and funding-application costs over every declared year and every author, including later and inactive authors. Income and transfers are excluded. Complete original ledgers must reconcile; unavailable cost is unknown, never zero. Native resource units are not money, compute, welfare or scientific truth.
